title: 3 Myths About Money That Hold You Back

segments.text: You've got some money beliefs that aren’t true.
These myths limit your financial growth.
It’s time to challenge what you think you know.
Wealth isn't reserved for the lucky; it's earned.
Unlearn those myths to redefine your money journey.
Want to break free from money myths? Follow along.

description: Explore three myths about money that are holding you back. Follow to unlock your full financial potential. 💰
